ICD form standard explanation: Standard Mode: best for faster responses, with higher battery use. The device still sleeps between short check-ins, but wakes much more often - commands and reads typically reach it within seconds to a few minutes. It is not permanently connected.
ICD form battery saver explanation with: Battery Saver Mode: best for longest battery life. The device sleeps most of the time and wakes on its own schedule. Commands may take up to %s to be delivered while it sleeps, and after a lost connection - for example an adapter restart - reconnecting can take just as long. Updates reported by the device itself are not delayed.
ICD form battery saver explanation: Battery Saver Mode: best for longest battery life. The device sleeps most of the time and wakes on its own schedule. Commands may be delayed while it sleeps, updates reported by the device itself are not.
ICD form ecosystem warning: Every ecosystem (e.g. Apple, Google) this device is paired with must support Battery Saver Mode (called Matter LIT (Long Idle Time) ICD), otherwise the device will appear offline or unresponsive there. You can switch back to Standard Mode later as long as no other ecosystem is registered for it.
ICD form iobroker restart warning: Do not enable Battery Saver Mode when this ioBroker instance or host is restarted regularly, for example nightly for backups. After every restart the device can take up to a full check-in interval - possibly hours - before it is reachable again.
ICD form resync explanation: Drops the local Battery Saver registration and reconnects from scratch. Use this when the device appears stuck offline although it should be reachable.
ICD confirm enable with interval: Enable Battery Saver Mode? The device will sleep most of the time. Commands may take up to %s to reach it; updates from the device itself are not delayed.
ICD confirm enable: Enable Battery Saver Mode? The device will sleep most of the time and commands may be delayed; updates from the device itself are not.
ICD confirm disable: Switch to Standard Mode? The device will wake much more often and respond faster, at the cost of higher battery use. It still sleeps briefly between check-ins - it does not become permanently connected. Switching back is only possible while no other ecosystem is registered for Battery Saver Mode with this device - this is verified after you confirm.
